source.universe: JRA flat, field size >=12, 3-win class or higher
source.protocol: Reconstruct Ability v1 from strictly prior high-class starts, rank by raw model logit, project P3 with the frozen race-coherent common-logit shift, and evaluate 3rd-to-4th Ability gaps only on unknown years 2025-2026.

ability_gap_3_to_4.metric: Ability Index rank3 - rank4; Ability Index = 50 + 10 * within-race z(raw logit)
ability_gap_3_to_4.reason: Even in the largest 20% of 3-to-4 Ability gaps, Ability rank4 still finished top3 in 42/140 races (30.0%). The gap is useful as a structural display but does not support automatic opponent deletion.

top3_probability_mass_concentration.definition: sum(Ability P3 for Ability ranks 1-3) / 3.0. Because projected Ability P3 sums to exactly 3.0 per race, this is a share of P3 mass, not the probability that all three horses finish top3.

same_grade_field_strength.metric: mean raw Ability logit of all runners in the race, compared only with historical races of the same current grade
same_grade_field_strength.meaning: History-based entrant-strength proxy. It is not the realized race level and must not be used as a Production betting gate without prospective validation.
same_grade_field_strength.history_coverage_guard: Show the strength band as lower-confidence when fewer than 70% of runners have at least 3 prior eligible JRA high-class starts.
